AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT {
            function swapEraser() {
				let entry = null;
				for (let i = 0; i < editingTools.count; i++) {
					let entryI = editingTools.itemAt(i).item;
					if (entryI.objectName === "eraserMenu") {
						entry = entryI;
						break;
					}
				}               
				if (root.selectedTool !== entry){
					root.eraserToolSelected(entry.pen.tool);
					requestPenSelect(entry, 0);
				}
				else{root.selectPen("primary");}
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
